environment.spotify: user-paused before work; do not access app

sequence.force_engine: STARLING_ENGINE=fast; actual fast/vulkan PowerVR device stderr required
sequence.expected_transcript: require every run transcript equals first result for that fixture and same across all arms
sequence.active_energy_scope: process launch through process exit, includes load/warmup/timed runs

sequence.force_engine: STARLING_ENGINE=ggml STARLING_GGML_DEVICE=CPU STARLING_GGML_THREADS=6; server actual backend CPU log required
sequence.warmup: server --warmup before /health ready; process launch to ready includes load and Q4 repack
sequence.latency: host monotonic HTTP /normalize wall; same ADB forward and request path for both arms
sequence.active_energy_scope: process launch through final response and graceful server termination

block_schedule.cooldown_rule: Before each block wait up to 180s for thermal status <=1 and battery temperature <370 deciC; if not reached record descriptive drift and disable directional latency/energy win claims.

analysis.latency: Fast: median of timed runs after excluding first 3 per fixture per block, report per-block medians and ABBA adjacent differences. S1: host-monotonic post-startup-warmup HTTP /normalize latency, one request per case per block; generic warmup need not warm each case shape. Report per-case values and paired blocks, not native-only or steady-state per-case latency. If cooling rule is breached, only descriptive timings and no directional win.
analysis.energy: Take timestamped charge-counter/voltage samples immediately before process launch and immediately after confirmed exit; active duration is the interval between these two sample timestamps. For each block, subtract idle discharge extrapolated across that duration using both pre and post idle slopes; compute a central estimate with their mean and an uncertainty interval from their minimum/maximum, widened by two empirical gauge steps per block. Convert uAh*mV/1e6 to mWh using mean active voltage. A directional win requires every adjacent baseline-minus-candidate energy contrast to remain strictly positive over this full uncertainty interval and exceed four gauge steps; if any interval reaches zero, charging, counter increase beyond one step, missing boundary, or temperature/cooling rule breach, report inconclusive. These are battery-side device estimates, not model-only joules.
analysis.load: Fast internal load header and total process duration separately (stdout may be buffered); S1 process-launch-to-ready includes warmup/repack, with internal load-stage separately. Warm request excluded from latency.
analysis.memory: Existing warmed PSS/GPU snapshots retained; during this pilot optionally sample process/global RAM outside timing path, do not sum dumpsys total PSS and graphics mtrack.
analysis.abort: Preserve partial raw output and mark incomplete if phone becomes charging, thermal >=2, battery >=42C, script timeout, engine mismatch, or duplicate/missing result.
